title: Quest Dev Copilot - Llama API Fine-Tuning Instructions

dataset_info.examples: Enhanced training data for Quest VR debugging

step_by_step_instructions.title: Access Llama API Dashboard
step_by_step_instructions.description: Go to https://llama.developer.meta.com/ and sign in with your API key

step_by_step_instructions.title: Navigate to Fine-Tuning
step_by_step_instructions.description: Click on the 'Fine-tuning' tab in the dashboard

step_by_step_instructions.title: Upload Dataset
step_by_step_instructions.description: Click 'Create' and upload the dataset file: /Users/carlos/UNREAL-META/fine_tuned_models/comprehensive_training_data.jsonl
step_by_step_instructions.notes: Ensure the file is in JSONL format with proper message structure

step_by_step_instructions.title: Start Fine-Tuning
step_by_step_instructions.description: Click 'Start' to begin the fine-tuning process
step_by_step_instructions.notes: The process may take several hours depending on dataset size

step_by_step_instructions.title: Monitor Progress
step_by_step_instructions.description: Track the job progress in the dashboard

step_by_step_instructions.title: Download Fine-Tuned Model
step_by_step_instructions.description: Once complete, download the model or use it directly via API
options: Use via API with model ID
